name: addons
description: UNVERIFIED FIRST DRAFT -- blind-authored from a plain-language description only, never run against real hardware. Login into the app, close any post-login notification dialogs, view the Add-ons screen, then log out. Steps 1-7 (dismiss system dialog through submit) are copied from the already-proven test-cases/login.json sequence (bugs 18-23, closed out end to end on real BrowserStack hardware for both platforms); steps 8+ (notifications, Add-ons, logout) are new guesses about this app's UI and have NOT been confirmed against a real screen. Expect this file to need the same bug-by-bug correction login.json did -- run it once via PHOENIX_BATCH_MODES=test-case, PHOENIX_TEST_CASE_FILE=test-cases/addons.json, and report back whatever the log/report actually shows so the guessed steps can be fixed from real evidence, not another guess.

steps.instruction: tap the Allow button to dismiss a system permission dialog
tap the LOGIN button on the home screen to open the login form
type the phone number into the phone/account number field
tap the PASSWORD tab to switch the form into password-entry mode
tap the password field to focus it
type the password into the password field
tap the LOGIN button to submit the login form
tap the Allow button to dismiss a system permission dialog
steps.note: CONFIRMED real bug on addons-run-android-1.log: this app fires a native Android runtime-permission dialog ("Allow MyYes to send you notifications?", Allow/Don't allow buttons) right after login submit, not a custom in-app popup with a close/X button -- the original guess here ("tap the close or X button...") never matched it, leaving the dialog on screen and blocking the Add-ons tap underneath it. Fixed by reusing the exact, already-proven "tap the Allow button..." instruction from step 1 above (same resolver match, same dialog shape), repeated here for whichever permission prompt(s) appear post-login.

steps.instruction: tap the Allow button to dismiss a system permission dialog
steps.note: Repeated in case a second permission dialog (e.g. contacts/location) stacks up after the notifications one -- still unconfirmed whether more than one actually appears; delete if a run shows only one.

steps.instruction: tap the Add-ons tab or menu item
steps.note: CONFIRMED working on addons-run-android-2.log -- the guessed instruction resolved and clicked correctly; the run got past this step to the next (new) failure.

steps.instruction: tap the X button to close the coach mark tutorial popup
steps.note: CONFIRMED real bug on addons-run-android-2.log: after reaching the Add-ons/Account area, a coach-mark tutorial overlay appears ("Your Account overview is easily accessible in the middle of the screen.", with a close icon at resource-id ivClose and a NEXT button at btnNext) sitting on top of the screen -- this was never guessed in the original draft, so it silently blocked every tap step after it, including the Profile/Logout ones below, each of which quietly failed to resolve against the real screen underneath. Fixed per direct confirmation of the real element (ivClose) by adding this step to tap it.

steps.instruction: tap the Profile or Account menu to find the logout option
steps.note: GUESS: logout may be directly visible on the Add-ons/home screen, or may require first opening a Profile/Account/More menu -- unconfirmed. Marked optional so a run where logout is already visible doesn't fail here. Still unverified past the coach-mark blocker above -- addons-run-android-2.log failed on the step after this one, so it's unclear yet whether this step itself resolved to anything real or simply found no match and was (correctly) skipped as optional.

steps.instruction: tap the LOGOUT or Log Out button to sign out of the app
